verdict.rationale: Railway documents deploying from a local machine via its CLI ('Develop locally and deploy from your terminal'), which loosely implies shipping local files rather than connecting a repo. Nothing confirms that no Git repo is required. Nothing shows deployments stay private until published; the homepage instead says public endpoints are live from the moment you deploy. missing for 10: explicit folder/file upload without Git, documented private-until-publish deployment state, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy a project by uploading a folder of files directly, with no Git repo required and the new deployment kept private until I choose to publish it

citations.quote: Develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI.
